<translate>
<!--T:4-->
'''Master Tien''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives on the [[Special:MyLanguage/World Martial Arts Tournament|World Martial Arts Tournament]] island, in the oceans of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Chiaotzu|Chiaotzu]]. He is the only master who teaches the Dodon Ray, the Tri-Beam and the Neo Tri-Beam, and he trains characters of any alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Master Tien and Chiaotzu stand together on the island of the [[Special:MyLanguage/World Martial Arts Tournament|World Martial Arts Tournament]], about 130 blocks from the ring. The island generates once per world in the oceans: find it with {{Command|/dmzlocate budokai_tenkaichi}} or buy a map from a [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]] of tier 3 or higher (1 Map and 4 Gold Ingots).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
Master Tien's '''Skills''' and '''Train''' are open at any [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]]. Below 41 he greets you with a colder line (for example "The Tri-Beam is a technique for protecting others, not for hurting them."), and below 25 he treats you as hostile. Server owners can change both limits in the NPC alignment rules (see [[Special:MyLanguage/NPC Placement and Alignment|NPC Placement and Alignment]]).
</translate>

<translate>

<translate>
<!--T:21-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.

<!--T:22-->
After the Neo Tri-Beam you can fire up to 3 follow-up shots within a 3-second window. Each one costs 10% of your maximum health and needs at least 20% health left.
</translate>

<translate>
== Side quests == <!--T:23-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:24-->
Master Tien gives no side quests himself, but Chiaotzu's ''A Gift for Tien'' has you bring him 10 Cooked Salmon and 10 Bread. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Chiaotzu|Chiaotzu]].
</translate>

{{Note|type=config|title=<translate><!--T:25--> Server settings</translate>|<translate><!--T:26--> What he teaches is the <code>tien</code> list of <code>skillOfferings</code> in <code>config/dragonminez/skills.json</code>. Existing servers get it added the next time the file loads, without touching their other values.</translate>}}
